acceptanceCriteria: Provide one minimal native-Go provider, a declared version/profile contract and a reproducible conformance invocation over the existing file and contained command transports.

Consumers bind exact supported profile/provider identities; unsupported versions fail explicitly and upgrades cannot silently change an existing pinned invocation. Specify the supported compatibility window and test old/current records without promising arbitrary historical engine execution.

Reuse and document valid, stale, malformed, ambiguous, repository-mismatched and unsupported fixtures; demonstrate that optional external evidence stays separate and does not change the core receipt or inherit governing authority.

Prove one provider can be authored and exercised in a clean checkout using only the kit and qualified local prerequisites. Retain process timeout, output bounds, environment isolation and no-descendant-on-interruption evidence for command transport.

Keep the default product unchanged: no runtime downloads, remote transport, daemon or general plugin host. Retain MCP as proposed and remote as outside the default profile; document rollback and both protocol/AGPL path boundaries.
body: Owner requested all five n8n-inspired improvements as part of Corvint 0.7.0 on 2026-09-22. Original Go implementations of the patterns; no n8n source import. Extend the cited existing mechanisms. This ticket records release intent, not delivery or promotion. Before implementation is called complete, update the owning indexed spec with stable requirements, non-goals, failure modes, acceptance evidence and rollback, and finish normal CEM/OCM, independent review and mandatory gates. Build on docs/specs/external-evidence-provider-v0.md, its V1/V2 extensions, external-evidence-provider-transports-v0.md and the existing internal/extevidence conformance fixtures. Respect analyzer-capability-contract-v0.md where applicable without promoting its unqualified launch boundary. Prior art: https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n-docs/blob/main/docs/connect/create-nodes/build-your-node/reference/versioning.md.

completion.reason: Delivered 2026-09-23 through PR #88 (integration of wave-1/2 PRs into main). PR #76: versioned local evidence-provider authoring kit. NOT_OBSERVED: owner acceptance and an external adopter.

title: Package a versioned local evidence-provider authoring kit
